chunks: And Zurārah narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about what is disliked for the muhrim to wear, so he said: "He may wear every garment except a single garment that he wears as a tunic."

key_terms.أَحَدِهِمَا: one of the two Imams, referring to either al-Bāqir or al-Ṣādiq, peace be upon them
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurārah, the transmitter of this hadith
key_terms.يَتَدَرَّعُهُ: he wears it in the manner of a tunic or shirt

ai.seo_question: What clothing is disliked or prohibited for a muhrim to wear in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding clothing in the state of ihram. It indicates that the muhrim may wear garments generally, except for a single garment worn in the manner of a tunic, clarifying a restriction related to ihram dress.
